content.arguments: {"code":"const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); await fs.writeFile('ptc-created.txt', 'created by sandboxed Node\\n'); const written = await fs.readFile('ptc-created.txt', 'utf8') === 'created by sandboxed Node\\n'; const shell = await tools.bash({ command: 'pwd', description: 'Report the current workspace directory' }); inspect({ written, emptyEnvironment: Object.keys(process.env).length === 0, sameWorkspace: process.cwd() === shell.stdout.text.trim() }); return;","description":"Verify Node file policy and execution context"}
